_comment: MTG_REAL_PAY_ATTACK_PIN (docs/design/mana-completeness-oracle.md 13.2). FiveColour s1130288 gi287's turn-5 board. The plan casts Two-Headed Hellkite and drains 2 with Deathrite #1 (exiling Unite the Coalition). The engine's own payment taps Breeding Pool for a {G} that floats and empties, so at the search's declaration the second Deathrite is the only untapped source: 1 mana pays for nothing in hand, and FiveColourProvider::ShouldAttackWith sends it in (16 -> 14 -> 8, and T6's swing is exactly lethal). Under MTG_REAL_PAY_SCRIPT the oracle's DOMINATING payment leaves Breeding Pool untapped, so on the REAL board Deathrite + Pool make 2 mana, Bloom Tender {1}{G} is castable, and the same hold kept Deathrite home: 5 damage, opponent at 9, nothing cast in main 2, and T6's attack one short (T6 -> T7). The pin makes the scripted main declare the attackers the search's own apply board declared. With MTG_REAL_PAY_ATTACK_PIN=0 this fixture wins on turn 7.
